findings.evidence: `Representation/Comodule/TensorProduct.lean:82-97,125-144` already proves the same `tensorCombine`/`distribBaseChange` calculation and transported tensor action; `Representation/Comodule/Trivial.lean:58-66` proves every point acts identically on a trivial comodule using the same pure-tensor calculation repeated here at lines 134-144.
findings.fix: Generalize/factor the existing calculations into public `Comodule.endOfPoint` tensor and trivial-comodule lemmas under the weaker noncommutative-H hypotheses, then derive both the existing `PointRepresentation` theorems and these categorical specializations from them.
findings.issue: `distribute_pointAction_tensor` and the inductions supporting `endOfPoint_tensor` duplicate the proof and result shape of `PointRepresentation.evaluated_tensorCombine`/`tensor_action_apply`; `endOfPoint_trivial` likewise rederives `PointRepresentation.trivial_action` at the underlying-map level.

summary: The new proofs duplicate existing tensor and trivial-action infrastructure instead of factoring reusable comodule-level lemmas.
